text.offer: Aye, someone eager to do this favor for me. Undoubtedly you've heard that the orc mines have reopened. Well, them orcs mine a strain of iron ore that's of a much higher grade than what we can get out of the stripped out Jasper mines. Bring me some ore, and I'll use the last of what I have now to make you a coat of arms.
text.progress: Find a chunk of ore in the orc caves and bring it back to the blacksmith of Tos.
text.complete: Ah, this will make for some fine weapons and armor! Thank you greatly. In your absence, I have fashioned a shield which displays your guild's crest and colors. Wear it forth proudly, you have done well for your guild this day.
